## Orientation

Fix task after verification fail. Own tests/test_close_batch.py (and close_batch.py only if CLI wiring needs a tiny hook). Do not edit skills or contract.

Worktree: /home/andrewyin/affidavit--oracle-witnesses. No .artifacts/. No adaptive-artifacts.

Before commit:
  flock /tmp/oracle-witnesses-git.lock -c 'git -C /home/andrewyin/affidavit--oracle-witnesses add -A -- . ":!.artifacts" && git -C /home/andrewyin/affidavit--oracle-witnesses commit -m "fix-oracle-cli-tests"'

The verify acceptance filter is: -k 'cli and (oracle or freeze or assertion_level or amendment)'
Test function names must include both `cli` and one of those tokens.

## Requirements (R5)

Close path refuses hash drift without approved amendment and refuses missing assertion-level red — prove via real close-batch CLI.

## Design Invariants

Frozen hashes are close authority; assertion-level red required; parent writes store.

## Decisions

oracle-loop-shape; assertion-level-red
record.subject: fix-oracle-cli-tests
